plan.coverage_notes: The plan attacks the subject across axes the profile cares about: procedural techniques (ablation, LAA closure), pharmacologic management (anticoagulation, antiarrhythmics), management strategy debates (rate vs rhythm), and evidence sources (RCTs, registries, meta-analyses, guidelines). It deliberately avoids angles the reader is not interested in: basic science (animal models, genetics) and health economics. The assumption that the reader wants 'bottom-line clinical takeaways' drove the focus on outcomes, complications, and synthesized evidence (meta-analyses, guidelines).
